CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates kept by xiaodoudou: homelabdash, a homelab dashboard configured in one YAML file; PlexIPTV, which brings an IPTV subscription into Plex as live TV; and SyncYomi, a self-hosted server that keeps a manga library and reading progress in sync between TachiyomiSY and Komikku devices. Each template links to its project, and problems go to that project's GitHub issues.
